intro: Vibhavadi Hospital sits on Ngamwongwan Road where it meets Vibhavadi Rangsit, in the Kaset–Chatuchak area. Cars can reach it from several directions, but there aren't many places you can literally walk to the hospital gate from. The closest options are a serviced apartment inside the hospital's own building and dormitory-style rooms in Kasetsart University across the road. Most other hotels sit in the Vibhavadi Rangsit sois and over on the Ratchayothin side, about 1 to 2 kilometres away, a few minutes by taxi or motorbike taxi. Nearby you have the SRT Red Line at Bang Khen, the BTS at Kasetsart University, and the MRT at Phahon Yothin for onward trips. It suits patient families, people in for a check-up, and anyone making several trips to and from the hospital. Ngamwongwan and Vibhavadi get quite congested at rush hour, so leave a little extra travel time.

blocks.html: Short answer: Vibhavadi Hospital is on Ngamwongwan Road at the Vibhavadi Rangsit junction, in the Kaset–Chatuchak area. The closest place to stay is Vibhavadi Tower, a serviced apartment inside the hospital complex (from about ฿1,400/day). Next are KU Home inside Kasetsart University, about an 11-minute walk, and Cinnamon Residence roughly 600 metres away (from about ฿950). For a budget room with a kitchen, look at Daratorn Vibhavadi. For 4-star there's Northgate Ratchayothin and Maruay Garden, about 1.8–1.9 km away. Rates run from roughly ฿700 to a few thousand a night.

faq.q: Are there hotels within walking distance of Vibhavadi Hospital?
faq.a: The closest is Vibhavadi Tower, a serviced apartment in the same building as the hospital, so you take the lift down and you're there. Next is KU Home inside Kasetsart University, about an 11-minute walk. Most other hotels are 1 to 2 kilometres away, so it's easier to take a taxi or a motorbike taxi than to walk.

faq.q: How do I get to Vibhavadi Hospital from Don Mueang Airport?
faq.a: Don Mueang is very close, about a 15–20 minute taxi ride depending on traffic, roughly ฿100–150. If you're not in a hurry, you can take the SRT Red Line from Don Mueang to Bang Khen station, which is near the hospital, then a short motorbike taxi or taxi.

faq.q: What kind of stay is best for a multi-day recovery?
faq.a: If you'll be there several days or recovering after treatment, look at a serviced apartment with a kitchen, such as Vibhavadi Tower in the hospital's own building, or Cinnamon Residence and Daratorn Vibhavadi, which have a small kitchen and fridge so you can cook. They book by the day or the month and are more comfortable than a single hotel room for longer stays with family helping out.
